budgets.limit: one route family or one shared integrity boundary per production commit
one user-facing responsibility per shared component; split when API, layout, and state responsibilities mix
atomic, form, and layout components must not import route views, typed API clients, or Pinia domain stores
extract repeated UI or headless behavior after the second real route consumer
no new frontend dependency unless current Vue, VueUse, Pinia, Router, i18n, and utility capabilities are insufficient and review is recorded
each slice requires focused tests plus formatting, lint, typecheck, build, and targeted browser evidence before its task is checked

stop_conditions: A slice requires a new backend contract, persistence rule, permission rule, or state machine.
A production component would import prototype fixtures or duplicate a shared behavior contract.
The change exceeds the allowed roots in scope.json.
